grammar.title: 语法知识 倒装句
lines: 3 倒装句结构 § Those kings will always be there to guide you. 那些逝去的国王们将会一直守护着你。
肯定倒装: So + 助动词 + sb.(主语)
否定倒装: N either + 助动词 + sb.(主语)
I will always be there to guide you too. = So will I. 我也会的。
情况 例句
时态一致，人称一致 A: I like Lee Hong. B: I like Lee Hong, too. = So do I.
第三人称单数 A: I hate money. B: I hate money, too. = So do I. C: She hates money, too. = So does she.
情态动词 A: I can do it. B: I can do it, too. = So can I. C: He can do it, too. = So can he.
一般过去 A: They were young. B: I was young, too. = So was I. C: She was young, too. = So was she.
A: I went to bed late. B: I went to bed late too. = So did I. C: Sam went to bed late, too. = So did Sam.
一般过去否定 I didn’t go to school last week. I didn’t go to school, either . = N either did I. She didn’t go to school either . = N either did she.
否定倒装 I am not a nurse. I am not a nurse, either . = N either am I. She is not a nurse, either . = N either is she.
现在完成时否定 I haven’t had breakfast. I haven’t had breakfast either . = N either have I. 优先选择助动词 He hasn’t had breakfast either. = N either has he. 选择助动词
一般过去时否定 I was not a good student. I was not a good student either . = N either was I. Sara was not a good student either . = N either was she.
